audit.purpose: Read-only priority-case failure audit; no labels changed, no training performed.
audit.undertriage_definition: From exact fresh-test predictions: actual serious/critical; argmax predicted label has lower urgency rank where needs_review < minor < serious < critical. This reproduces nine cases (all actual critical). This is raw classifier undertriage, not the threshold-routed result.
audit.routing_rule_recomputed: If maximum raw softmax < 0.65 route to human_review/needs_review; otherwise automatic argmax. Threshold is explicitly not calibrated.
audit.method: Text-first notes were written as separate fields before model probabilities are presented in the per-case comparison. This is not a genuinely blinded independent human review: the agent had already inspected output containing the source predictions during setup, and is not a fluent human reviewer or accountable responder. Interpretations are provisional and should not be treated as label decisions.

rubric_review.finding: The dataset provenance records 0.2-B. annotation_guide.md calls itself a draft and has no 0.2-B version tag. Challenge-intake README says 0.2-B Policy B formal accountable approval is pending. Exact canonical rubric text was not located. Interpretations therefore rely on the accessible provisional guide, not a verified canonical 0.2-B artifact.
